knowledge:
- key_parameters: useTheseGenes=A priori filter to specify which genes to consider (e.g., those with at least expression data) ;; MOcolors=Color mapping for different omics in reports ;; formula=Formula for Kaplan-Meier survival curves (e.g., "Surv(days, status) ~ expPC2 + met2k") ;; moduleNumber=Specific module index to plot or analyze ;; sortBy=Vector of covariates/annotations to sort heatmaps by ;; additionalAnnotations=Patient-level metadata (e.g., clinical data) to add to heatmaps ;; pvalueThr=P-value threshold for filtering in runSupertest ;; zscoreThr=Z-score threshold for filtering in runSupertest ;; excludeColumns=Columns to exclude from supertest analysis
- alternatives: Gene-set analysis=When topological information is lost, only the pathway test function must be used instead of the module test ;; Topological PCA=Suggested for pathway-level tests to guide the data reduction step using pathway topology, instead of sparse PCA
- when_to_use: When analyzing multi-omic datasets (such as expression, methylation, mutation, or copy number variation) alongside clinical survival or two-class data, and wanting to identify dysregulated biological pathways or pathway modules while accounting for gene-gene interaction topology.
- pitfalls: Reproducibility=Forgetting to set a seed (set.seed) before running tests, which can lead to non-reproducible results due to dimensionality reduction or resampling ;; Methylation mapping=Methylation data often has multiple CpG clusters per gene; users must provide a dictionary to convert cluster names into genes in the specific arguments ;; Missing topology=Using module tests on gene-sets where topological information is lost (only pathway tests should be used in this case)

workflows.name: multi_omic_survival_module_analysis
workflows.intent: Test survival association of pathway connected components (modules) using multi-omic data and visualize results.
input: multiOmics_data.RData (MultiAssayExperiment object containing multi-omic matrices and clinical survival data)
pathways.RData (List of pathways in graphite Pathway or graphNEL format)
workflows.stages: 1. Load multi-omic data and pathway topologies ;; 2. Filter genes to consider ;; 3. Run survival module test using multiOmicsSurvivalModuleTest ;; 4. Generate a tabular summary of top modules using multiPathwayModuleReport ;; 5. Visualize module report using plotModuleReport ;; 6. Visualize module position in the pathway graph using plotModuleInGraph ;; 7. Plot Kaplan-Meier survival curves for modules using plotModuleKM ;; 8. Plot heatmap of original omic profiles for module genes using plotModuleHeat ;; 9. Test for significant omic interactions using runSupertest
workflows.code:
library(MOSClip)
library(MultiAssayExperiment)
library(kableExtra)

data("reactSmall")
data("multiOmics")

availableOmicMethods()

genesToConsider <- row.names(experiments(multiOmics)$exp)

moduleSurv <- lapply(reactSmall, function(g) {
  set.seed(1234)
  fcl = multiOmicsSurvivalModuleTest(multiOmics, g, 
                                     useTheseGenes = genesToConsider)
  fcl
 })

moduleSummary <- multiPathwayModuleReport(moduleSurv)

plotModuleReport(moduleSurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
                 MOcolors = c(exp = "red", met = "green", 
                              cnv = "yellow", mut = "blue"))

plotModuleInGraph(moduleSurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
                  pathList = reactSmall, 
                  moduleNumber = 4)

plotModuleKM(moduleSurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
             moduleNumber = 4, 
             formula = "Surv(days, status) ~ expPC2 + met2k", 
             paletteNames = "Paired", risk.table = TRUE, inYears = TRUE)

additionalA <- colData(multiOmics)
additionalA$status[additionalA$status == 1] <- "event"
additionalA$status[additionalA$status == 0] <- "no_event"
additionalA$PFS <- as.factor(additionalA$status)
additionalA$status <- NULL
additionalA$years <- round(additionalA$days/365.24, 0)
additionalA$days <- NULL

plotModuleHeat(moduleSurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
               moduleNumber = 4, 
               paletteNames = c(exp = "red", met = "green", 
                                cnv = "yellow", mut = "blue"),
               additionalAnnotations = additionalA, 
               additionalPaletteNames = list(PFS = "violet", years = "teal"), 
               sortBy = c("expPC2", "met2k", "PFS", "years"), 
               withSampleNames = FALSE)

runSupertest(moduleSummary, pvalueThr = 0.05, zscoreThr = 0.05, 
             excludeColumns = c("pathway", "module"))

workflows.name: multi_omic_survival_pathway_analysis
workflows.intent: Test survival association of entire pathways using topology-guided data reduction and visualize results.
input: multiOmicsTopo_data.RData (MultiAssayExperiment object with topology-guided settings and clinical survival data)
pathways.RData (List of pathways in graphite Pathway or graphNEL format)
workflows.stages: 1. Load multi-omic data with topological settings and pathway topologies ;; 2. Run survival pathway test using multiOmicsSurvivalPathwayTest ;; 3. Plot multi-pathway report using plotMultiPathwayReport ;; 4. Plot heatmap of original omic profiles for pathway genes using plotPathwayHeat ;; 5. Plot Kaplan-Meier survival curves for pathways using plotPathwayKM
workflows.code:
data("multiOmicsTopo")

pathwaySurv <- lapply(reactSmall, function(g) {
  set.seed(1234)
  fcl = multiOmicsSurvivalPathwayTest(multiOmicsTopo, g, 
                                      useTheseGenes = genesToConsider)
  })

plotMultiPathwayReport(pathwaySurv, 
                       MOcolors = c(exp = "red", mut = "blue", 
                                    cnv = "yellow", met = "green"))

plotPathwayHeat(pathwaySurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
                sortBy = c("expPC1", "cnvPOS", "PFS"), 
                paletteNames = c(exp = "red", met = "green",
                                 mut = "blue", cnv = "yellow"), 
                additionalAnnotations = additionalA, 
                additionalPaletteNames = list(PFS = "violet", years = "teal"), 
                withSampleNames = FALSE)

plotPathwayKM(pathwaySurv[["Activation of Matrix Metalloproteinases"]], 
              formula = "Surv(days, status) ~ expPC1 + cnvPOS", 
              paletteNames = "Paired")
